title: US-045 The hotfix goes back into integration
description: Amina opens the second Pull Request of her hotfix: the same branch, into integration, so that the next release does not undo the fix.
prBody:
The fix shipped to production through preprod. This brings it into integration, so the next release carries it instead of undoing it.

Story: US-045 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review it and merge it into integration. Lab 3.8 step 4.
